raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Dartmouth Office of the President page and incorrectly stated that Nathan Lord (Henry C. Lord’s father) graduated from Dartmouth College, conflating an honorary D.D. (1828) with his alma mater. The correct information (on that very page and other sources) is that Nathan Lord graduated from Bowdoin College. This misreading introduced the wrong conclusion and could have led to an incorrect final answer.
